items.item_text: Bachelors degree required.
Bachelor-s degree with a Business or Economics major preferred.

Masters degree in Business Administration with financial focus, Health Care Administration, Public Health or other related field strongly preferred. Demonstrated equivalent experience with Bachelors degree will be considered.
Minimum eight (8) years of experience in financial planning, modeling, analysis, strategic planning or equivalent required.
Prefer at least three (3) years experience in analytical role in health insurance industry.
Leadership and talent management experience, five or more years required. Expertise in motivating and developing high performing staff.
Prefer three (3) years of corporate financial planning including capital budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis experience.
Experience leading financial planning process changes from concept through implementation.
Experience with data management, business intelligence and benchmarking preferred.
Dedication to maintaining and building an inclusive culture and values aligned with principles of diversity. Specific experience/qualifications include the following:

A deep knowledge of and experience in capital planning, analysis and approval processes to enable incumbent to analyze complex capital approval requests and capital budgets, and to advise senior management as to their suitability for approval. Core technical competencies: strong capital budgeting and financial modeling skills (discounted cash flows, NPV, IRR), experience with integrated capital budgeting, sensitivity/scenario analysis, portfolio optimization and investment prioritization

Demonstrated experience working with IT/technology investments, major capital programs, M&A or strategic investments, and familiarity with healthcare provider/health plan operating and regulatory environments where relevant
Annual Ten Year Capital Plan Development
The annual Ten Year Capital Plan includes all capital investments, including facilties (hospitals, clinics, etc.), equipment, IT and capitalizable strategic projects.

Leads development of the annual Ten Year Capital Plan, including setting guidance across markets, consolidation and critical review of market level Ten Year Capital Plan submissions, modeling, and preparation of related materials to support review and approval by Executive Leadership and the Board of Directors.

Identifies and analyzes plan drivers, leveraging all available planning, modeling, and reporting tools. Ensures 10 Year Capital Plan (dollars and metrics) align with the enterprise-s Strategic Plan and Long Range Economic Plan, including the investment portfolio outcomes such as IRR, maintence scores, and care delivery system supply requirements.
Co-drives with Delivery System Strategy, National Facilities Design & Construction and National IT process communications with market leadership.
Co-drives with Delivery System Strategy, National Facilities Design & Construction and National IT leadership reviews across key stakeholders, gaining alignment on assumptions and approvals.
Provides decision support to market stakeholders providing proactive insights and perspectives and challenging assumptions to ensure optimal outcomes.

Ensures efficient and comprehensive use of available analytic tools owned by National FP&A, KP Insight, Delivery System Strategy and National Facilities Design & Construction. Identifies and ensures adoption of industry analytic best practices.
Evolves the Ten Year Capital Planning approach to keep up with business needs in an increasingly dynamic environment.
Annual Capital Budget Development and ongoing performance management to Budget

Leads development of the annual Capital Budget, including setting guidance across markets, consolidation and critical review of market level Capital Budget submissions, modeling, and preparation of related materials to support review and approval by Executive Leadership and the Board of Directors.
Ensures Capital Budget (dollars and metrics) align with the enterprise-s Strategic Plan and Long Range Economic Plan.
Co-drives with Delivery System Strategy and National Facilities Design & Construction process and communications with market leadership.
Co-drives with Delivery System Strategy and National Facilities Design & Construction leadership reviews across key stakeholders, gaining alignment on assumptions and approvals.
Accountable for monthly financial oversight including budget to actual reporting and variance driver analaysis. Tracks adhoc (unbudgeted) capital requests.
Capital Approval Committee (CAC)

The CAC is a capital approval governance committee that includes the Enterprise CFO (chair) and four to six other national EVP. All capital business cases that exceeding $25M require CAC approval and all capital business cases that exceed $150M also require Board of Directors approval.
Serves as primary support to meeting chair (Enterprise CFO). Coordinates development of CAC approval forms and Board resolutions.

Advises business case sponsors, preparing sponsors for presentations to the CAC or Board of Directors. Leads materials review cycle with project sponsors, ensuring presentations to CAC are complete and informative. Anticipates CFO questions and secures responses prior to CAC.

Accountable for all aspects of the capital project business case process flow after initial market or service submission. Provides advisory and consultative services, creates summary presentations, leads project reviews, and manages approvals process.
Executes CAC directives assigned to Executive Director which may include post approval monitoring to ensure sponsor follow through on CAC mandates related to specific business cases
Chairs a Market CFO forum ensuring alignment on benefits outlined in large Investment Portfiolio business cases before advancing to CAC review.
Leads post implementation evaluation processes, ensuring benefits realization for all business case approved by the Board of Directors.
Investments Strategic Working Group (ISWG)

The ISWG is a sub-comittee to CAC that is chaired by the Enterprise CFO. The ISWG-s scope focuses on IT investments (approximately 30% of the total Capital budget) and sets the annual capital allocations/budgets for each of the Investment Portfolios (IP) (i.e. Care Delivery, Business & Analytics, Heatlh Plan, IT/Secruity, etc-)
Serves as primary support to meeting chair (Enterprise CFO). Manages and executes on ISWG directives.
Lead development of the national ISWG and IP level multi-year and annual target allocations.
Manages and reports on portfolio prioritization in support of national strategy sllignemnt and maximization of economic value.

Manages and supports the Business Functions and Data and Analytics Investment Portfolios including multi-year planning, project funding prioritization, business case review, project and portfolio target allocation performance.
Policy Maintenance and Enforcement

Accountable for maintenance of policy 5c (the KP policy that governs the capital request and approval process). This includes partnering with CAC chair on revisions to ensure relevant governance controls remain in place to enable achievement of capital planning and project approval strategy and objectives.
Monitors adherence to policy 5c for all capital requests and approvals.
Continuous Quality Improvement

Accountable for ongoing process improvements across the capital management spectrum inclusive of investment analysis, benefits realization, post approval review, business case methodology, SEFM (Standard Economic and Financial Modeling) and benefit realization.
Leads implementation of of industry leading capital planning technology tools to enable best practices, standardization, data centralization, and process streamlining.
Develops capital portfolio views, enabling holistic review of investments.
High performing team
Develops high performing analytical team responsible for capital planning through effective recruiting, mentoring and coaching.
Demonstrated history of developing and leading high performing teams.
A background in a capital intensive or IT intensive industry may be considered.
Demonstrated history in providing financial leadership in a large, complex business, serving as a strategic business partner to the senior team.
CPA or CMA preferred.
Demonstrated history of leveraging information technology strategies for financial transaction and decision support systems.
Expertise in capital planning and analysis, financial modeling. Thorough knowledge of process and tool enhancements, optimization and financial systems integration.
Strong ability to analyze, understand and communicate complex issues and capital cases required. Strong ability to manage in a dynamic environment required.
Executive presence and excellent communication (written and verbal) and negotiation skills required.
Ability to build effective partnerships and influence other leaders.
Ability to consistently demonstrate integrity, prudence, high energy, initiative, and self-confidence.

Customer focused with outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to interact with a range of stakeholders to establish effective relationships at all levels of the organization. Ability to work collaboratively in a matrix environment, while developing effective relationships and achieving results required.
